pullQuote: I build software that scales—from thoughtful user experiences to resilient systems behind the scenes.
paragraph: I'm a full-stack developer based in Cebu City, Philippines, and a Magna Cum Laude BSIT graduate. I ship modern web products from concept to deployment—clean UI, reliable APIs, and maintainable architecture. Recent work spans inventory platforms, clinic operations systems, campus network monitoring, and production consulting with Next.js and Supabase. I care about clear engineering, measurable outcomes, and software people actually want to use.
